newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes softer on mark, dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes softer on mark, dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev softened to 995.30-996 per mark at the close from the opening's 995-996 due to increased foreign currency demand for current payments from final clients, dealers said.
* The lev closed at 1,813-1,816 per dollar compared to the morning's 1,804-1,806 in line with firmer dollar/mark on global markets.

* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark as an anchor currency from July 1 under an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism called a currency board system and aimed at restoring confidence in the lev and stabilising the economy.
* Under the system the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at 995 levs bid and 1,000 ask. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
